name: io.github.Totti0135/model-council
title: Model Council
description: Consult other LLMs as tools — ask them, compare their answers, synthesize a conclusion.

environmentVariables.name: COUNCIL_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated short ids for the models to seat, e.g. 'gpt5,glm'. Each id then takes its own <ID>_BASE_URL, <ID>_API_KEY, <ID>_MODEL and optional <ID>_FORMAT (openai or anthropic). Omit to use a config file instead.

environmentVariables.name: COUNCIL_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON config file, for rosters large enough that several models share one endpoint. Defaults to ~/.config/model-council/config.json when that exists.
